Class WorkoutDAO

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.db.WorkoutDAO
public class WorkoutDAO extends Object
Saves, loads, updates and deletes workouts and their exercises in the SQLite database.

Follows the DAO (Data Access Object) pattern: all SQL for the workouts and exercises tables lives here, so the screens never touch the database directly. Multi-step writes run inside a single transaction, so a failure part-way through leaves the database unchanged.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public void save(User user, Workout workout)
      Saves a workout and every one of its exercises for the given user, in one transaction. The user must already exist in the users table.
      Parameters:
      user - the user the workout belongs to
      workout - the workout to save, including its exercises
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if the workout or any exercise cannot be saved

    • findAllByUsername

      public List<Workout> findAllByUsername(String username)

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the user's workouts, or an empty list if none or if loading fails

    • deleteAllForUser

      public void deleteAllForUser(String username)
      Deletes every workout and exercise belonging to the given user, in one transaction. Used by the Settings page's "Clear All Data" action. Does not touch their account, goals (those live in LocalProfileStore, not the database), or scheduled workouts.
      Parameters:
      username - the user whose workout data to delete
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if the data cannot be deleted

    • migrate

      public static void migrate(Connection connection) throws SQLException
      Adds the name column to a workouts table created before sessions could be named. Safe to run on every startup; does nothing if the column already exists.
      Parameters:
      connection - the open database connection
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the table cannot be inspected or altered
